alert_lead: Not quiet. A Henderson dealer cut several EVs at once. Two new dealer STRONGs: a 2021 Kona Electric Limited 32k at $15,990 fees-in, and a 2023 IONIQ 5 SE 53.6k at $18,990. The 2023 Niro EV Wind dropped to $16,990 and is upgraded to STRONG. The STRONG 2023 Bolt EV fell from $18,038 to $16,999. In LV, the CX-5 Signature STRONG is down $500 to $18,696. Private STRONGs are still live at the same prices: LV 2019 Leaf SV $9,995 and South Gate 2020 CX-5 GT $13,500. Mach-E is unchanged (Globul 2022 Premium 82.6k $20,999). Nothing STRONG was sold or removed.
